question: Should OpenClaw authorize this exact runtime dependency addition and accept the 1Password service-account-token-to-validated-local-op executable boundary for the bundled plugin?
rationale: The patch’s intended security model is a repository policy and supply-chain decision; it cannot be resolved safely by an automated code repair.

options.title: Authorize the current design
options.body: A security or repository-admin reviewer approves the exact current head’s dependency graph and accepts the bounded local executable trust model after inspecting the package delta.

options.title: Defer the bundled provider
options.body: Keep the existing broker unchanged until maintainers choose a different dependency or credential-execution architecture.

recommendation.title: Authorize the current design
recommendation.body: A security or repository-admin reviewer approves the exact current head’s dependency graph and accepts the bounded local executable trust model after inspecting the package delta.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the closest merged bundled SecretRef-provider implementation and can provide the most relevant design context, while authorization itself remains a human security/admin decision.
